changelog:
- Tightened guardrails to never paste secrets into chat and prevent vault/sensitive data dumping.
- Added step to always ask for explicit user confirmation before delete/clear/remove operations.
- Marked secret reveal requests as high risk, advising against them and suggesting secure alternatives.
- Removed Homebrew and macOS/installation-specific steps from workflow to focus on generic binary checks.
- Clarified authentication/session handling and tmux usage in interactive flows.
summary: Use Keeper Commander CLI and Keeper Secrets Manager workflows when installing Keeper tooling, setting up profiles, signing in, running Keeper interactively,...
